## Try the sign change {.psf-lesson}

1. Factorise $2x^2+10x-48$ on paper.
2. Compare the signs with the previous check.
3. Select **Next** to check your working.

::: {.fragment}

Take out $2$: $2(x^2+5x-24)$. **P** $=-24$, **S** $=5$. The number with the larger absolute value is positive.

:::

::: {.fragment}

| Signed pair | Sum |
|:--|:--|
| $-1,\ 24$ | $23$ |
| $-2,\ 12$ | $10$ |
| $-3,\ 8$ | $5$ |
| $-4,\ 6$ | $2$ |

:::

::: {.fragment}

**F:** Select $-3,8$ because $-3+8=5$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

$2x^2+10x-48=2(x-3)(x+8)$

:::
